query: SELECT COALESCE(u.user_id, c.owner_id)::text AS "key!", min(a.email::text) AS label, count(*) AS "requests!", count(*) FILTER (WHERE (u.prompt_tokens IS NOT NULL OR u.completion_tokens IS NOT NULL) AND NOT coalesce(u.estimated, false)) AS "reported!", count(*) FILTER (WHERE u.estimated) AS "estimated!", coalesce(sum(u.prompt_tokens),0)::bigint AS "prompt_tokens!", coalesce(sum(u.completion_tokens),0)::bigint AS "completion_tokens!", sum(u.cached_tokens)::bigint AS cached_tokens, sum(u.reasoning_tokens)::bigint AS reasoning_tokens FROM usage u LEFT JOIN conversations c ON c.id = u.conversation_id LEFT JOIN users a ON a.id = COALESCE(u.user_id, c.owner_id) WHERE u.created_at >= $1 AND u.created_at < $2 GROUP BY COALESCE(u.user_id, c.owner_id) ORDER BY coalesce(sum(u.prompt_tokens),0) + coalesce(sum(u.completion_tokens),0) DESC, COALESCE(u.user_id, c.owner_id)::text LIMIT $3
